column1: # The two lines above are the file's declaration: the schema it is written against and
# the column order it uses. They are comments, so every existing reader skips them, but
# `pravapis validate-data` refuses a stems file that does not declare. Column order is
# then a fact about the file rather than a fact about whichever parser reads it.
# The etymology fact the loanword rules need: is this stem a Western borrowing?
# See src/pravapis/lexicon/stems.py for the format and data/NORMS.md for the policy.
# provenance:   cited | reviewed | derived | uncertain   — uncertain never fires
# A leading '-' marks an unanchored stem (may match anywhere in the word).
# The optional 6th column is for stems the regular alternations cannot derive.
# LONGEST MATCH WINS. That is how false friends are handled: native `класц` beats
# loan `клас` on класці, so no rule needs a lookahead.
# Taraškievica салён- is also the native adjective "salty", so the reverse is ambiguous
# and is deliberately not derived (the project leaves ambiguous forms alone).
# akanne wrote the etymological о as а, so no rule conditioned on the Narkamaŭka
# spelling can recover калёніял; it needs the explicit target.
# --- §67 Заўвага А: long-adapted loans whose hardness is fixed, so і → ы ---
# разынкі is written with ы in Narkamaŭka too — real Narkamaŭka text has "з цукрам,
# разынкамі і цэдрай" (data/eval/roundtrip_corpus.txt) — so §67 Заўвага А, which lists
# разынкі among the words where з/с stayed hard, describes a spelling the two
# orthographies share. Forward is harmless; the reverse invented разінкамі, which is why
# --- §67 Заўвага А: fixed soft, and the homonym pairs і exists to keep apart ---
# `native` here means only "the loanword alternations do not apply" — кракадзіл is a
# borrowing, but its і is permanent. Дзіна/дына, сіці/сыты and цік/тык are distinct
# words that і → ы would collapse into one another.
# --- §68: the bound nominal group -энсія / -энзія. The е of the stem hardens to э, and
# --- the і of the suffix stays soft — пэнсія, пэнсіі, пэнсію, пэнсіямі. Carried as stems
# --- rather than as one lexicon row per form: listing only the nominative left every
# the derived noun needs its own entry: its -нер also hardens, which пенс- alone misses
# --- §68 holds the line here: a word-final -сія / -зія keeps its і soft, so no stem in
# --- this file may give one ы. дывізі, гімназі and азіяц used to, all three `reviewed`
# --- rather than cited; the held-out corpus in data/eval/tarask/corpus.tsv writes
# --- дывізія, дывізіяў, гімназія, Азіі, Азіяцкай and неагрэсіі — 13 soft forms, no ы.
# --- клясычны and фізык stay, being §67's own cited examples and not -сія nouns.
# Every entry below replaced a lexicon row that covered only the citation form, found by
# scripts/check_paradigms.py. A stem carries the whole declension: расійскі converted but
# расійскага did not, and 365 paradigms were split that way.
# --- the adjective group (§50, §11б, §67): 68 paradigms, mechanically uniform ---
# медычны is a separate stem from медыцынскі, not a form of it
# Only one stem matches a word — the longest — so a compound carrying two changes
# needs its own entry: філалагічны takes both the філя- and the -лягічн-.
# --- §68 abstract suffix matrices: root е → э, suffix і left soft ---
# --- agentive -ер / -ор (§11б). Narkamaŭka reduces the suffix to -ар or softens it to
# §53 prefers кампутар — the direct English/Latin borrowing, without the iotated
# vowel. The recognised Taraškievica variant камп’ютэр is handled the other way
# round, as t2n rows in exceptions.tsv: two stems deriving one reverse key is a
# collision the inventory forbids, and кампутар must come back as one spelling.
# `сілез`, not `сілезі`: і → ы must reach the і after с and stop before the
# suffix's own і, which §68 keeps soft — Сылезія, never Сылезыя.
# n2t only: Сымон is also a Belarusian given name that Narkamaŭka spells that way —
# Сымон Будны, «Касьцёл Сьвятых Сымона і Алены» — so the reverse must never fire.
# --- §67: і → ы after a hard dental in a settled loan ---
# §67: hard з takes ы. Held as a stem, not the single lexicon row it used to be —
# that row converted крызіс and left крызісу and крызісны behind.
# §46: a velar before -ск- drops rather than mutating — never a цк cluster
# §11б: "пасьля зычных, акрамя л і заднеязычных (г (ґ), к, х)". Stems marked `cited`
# appear in the book's own list at §11б; `reviewed` ones are read against that rule.
# лідэр was listed here in error: Narkamaŭka writes лідэр with э too, so there is no
# alternation to apply and the stem produced лідэры → лідеры. Found by the audit.
# RESOLVED: -мент is stress-conditioned — -мэнт under stress, -мент without it — which no
# stem rule can see. loan.ment_stress owns it now, using a GrammarDB stress table. This
# row is gone rather than uncertain; see data/NORMS.md, loan.ment_stress.
# --- added in phase D1, from the misses the gold set named ---
# аналагічны → аналягічны keeps akanne's а; the bare noun аналаг → аналёг restores the
# etymological о and cannot be derived, so it lives in the lexicon (which wins first).
# сімвал → сымбаль is not derivable: the м becomes мб. The stem gets the consonant
# change; the noun's own endings (сімвалам → сымбалем) are a tier-2 matter and are not
# --- added after the first independent T → N measurement named them ---
# Narrowed to the adjective: tests/test_pipeline.py has Азія staying Азія, while the
# corpus writes азыяцкі. азіяц- reaches the adjective without touching the noun.
# -агрэсі is unanchored so it also reaches неагрэсія, рэагрэсія and the like; every
# word containing it is a Latin borrowing.
# --- named by the independent be-tarask gold set ---
# NOT added: еўрапей → эўрапэй. The be-tarask corpus writes эўрапэйскі (е → э under
# §11б), but tests/test_codification_2005.py encodes §52 as эўрапейскі, keeping the е.
# The citation wins over corpus usage, and adding the stem also raised the false-positive
# rate on the independent gold from 0.1% to 0.3%. See data/NORMS.md, "Unresolved".
# е handed to loan.ment_stress; the soft л stays here
# DELIBERATELY EMPTY. Збор 2005 зноска 55 does license ґ in a list of
# а[ґ]рэст, цу[ґ]лі, шва[ґ']ер ды інш."), and the alphabet footnote marks
# the letter as факультатыўна — optional. This project takes the other
# option: it writes г everywhere and never produces ґ. See data/NORMS.md,
# "Project decision: no ґ". The citation is kept here so the choice can be
# reversed by adding stems back, not re-researched.
# These block the soft-л rule for the whole paradigm, not just the listed form.
# Found by scripts/check_stem_collisions.py against GrammarDB, not by the gold set:
# клуб- is also a native root (клубень "tuber", клубасты, клубануць). The guards are
# exactly long enough to beat the loan stem `клуб` without swallowing клубе/клубам,
# which are locative and dative of the club.
# салонец is a soil type, not a drawing room.
# класці "to lay": beats the loan stem `клас` by being one character longer.
# падлогі is the genitive of падлога, not a -логія compound.
